purpose: Teach: 長田/井口/小西/宮澤/田辺/塩川/児玉/本間

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の長田部長を歓迎しろ
lines.style: Clear, authoritative opening. Measured pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard without needing to raise his voice. Slight pause after the name — he expects acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の井口課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the sales manager Iguchi's business trip schedule.
lines.style: Quiet, efficient. Clipped cadence — each task is a checkbox. Respectful but not deferential. The voice of someone already three steps ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の小西主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the technical director Konishi to lead this project.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no softening. Steady breath. The confidence of someone who has already decided and is simply announcing it. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の宮澤様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adopt the PR department's proposal from Miyazawa.
lines.style: Affirmative, brief. A small nod in the voice. Professional warmth — he agrees, and that's already decided. Moving on.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の田辺様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: I want you to consult with our advisor Tanabe.
lines.style: Deliberate instruction. Slight weight on the verb — this matters. Calm but clear. The phrasing shows respect for Tanabe's standing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の塩川様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate with accounting on Shiokawa's closing schedule.
lines.style: Brisk, professional. Each phrase sits flat — no flourish. He's already moving to the next item. Efficient and uncluttered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の児玉様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Entrust the new employee training to our HR director Kodama.
lines.style: Final assignment in the chain. Steady, authoritative. Slight emphasis on the responsibility — this is important. The tone of delegation that expects it to be done well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の本間様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask our legal department, Honma, to review the contracts.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Clean, professional. Slight upward lift on the final phrase — the acknowledgment that this concludes the briefing. He's already turning to action.
